OpenSpades
Offline browser port

This is an early, local-only port of the OpenSpades gameplay core. It runs the original C++ player movement, collision, weapon simulation, hitscan, grenade physics, voxel map and structural-collapse code as WebAssembly.

The WebGL renderer, browser interface, River Crossing arena, practice bots and offline host are new. The desktop OpenGL renderer, AngelScript skins and menus, networking, original game modes, and full graphical effects have not been ported. Practice bots use reduced damage and simple steering. This is not a feature-complete replacement for desktop OpenSpades.

Local game assets

Models and sounds were extracted from the OpenSpades 0.1.3 Windows release already in this workspace. They retain their original licenses. The sound pack contains restricted media which may not be redistributed separately from official releases. This build has not been published.

Original nonfree pack credits · Base skin credits · Asset provenance

Controls

WASD to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, Shift to sprint, Ctrl to crouch. Keys 1–4 select spade, block, firearm and grenade. Left mouse uses the tool; right mouse aims, digs three blocks, or draws a block line. R reloads, E resupplies near the green spawn, C changes block color, M expands the map, and Escape pauses.

Hold and release left mouse to throw a grenade. If a browser does not support mouse capture, hold a mouse button and drag to look. The entire simulation pauses when you leave the game. Reloading the page starts a fresh world; terrain and match progress are not saved.

Built for desktop browsers with WebGL 2 and WebAssembly. No CDN, account, external game server, or internet connection is needed after local setup.
